what: Hides the default cursor, and a 10px dot follows by 30% of the remaining distance every frame. Within 118px around a round button (well), the dot grows to 26px and vanishes. Inside the button a disc fills from .2x over .4s ease and sticks and separates gooey-style (blur 11 + alpha threshold) from a 30px mirror circle at the cursor position. The mirror circle follows the cursor by 40% per frame, and the button text color flips instantly to the background color. Over ordinary links with no liquid, the dot is hidden and the hand pointer is shown

options.follow: Share the dot follows each frame, default .3
options.mirror: Share the mirror circle follows per frame, default .4
options.reach: Distance beyond the button radius that still reacts (px), default 118
options.size · near: Dot diameter · diameter (px) it grows to near the button, default 10 · 26
options.push: Distance pulled toward the button (px) — exposed only through --fx-liquid-x and --fx-liquid-y, and translate is applied only to the buttons the page picks, default 6
options.blur · cut: Gooey filter blur and alpha threshold, default 11 · -9 — put data-fx-goo-liquid-cursor on the button="blur: 26; cut: -8" Can be given separately like this (original large button value)
options.[data-fx-part=well]: Sticky disc-fill button — the inner element rises above the disc. is-liquid is added
options.--fx-goo · --fx-goo-ink · --fx-goo-mirro: Disc and dot color (default --kf-ink) · text color after filling (default --kf-bg) · mirror circle diameter (30px) · filter margin (130px)

note: On devices without a finger (hover: none) it does nothing. Under reduced motion the dot and mirror circle attach with no delay and the fill-up transition is off. Putting overflow: hidden on a button clips the mirror circle
